avoid_supplements.name: Chromium (high-dose >200 mcg/day)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Enhances insulin sensitivity and may potentiate hypoglycemic effects, increasing risk of severe hypoglycemia
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid or use only under medical supervision with frequent glucose monitoring and potential insulin dose adjustment

avoid_supplements.name: Ginseng (Panax)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Increases insulin secretion and peripheral glucose uptake, may cause additive hypoglycemic effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; monitor blood glucose closely if discontinuing; adjust insulin dose as needed

avoid_supplements.name: Fenugreek (seeds/extract)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Slows gastric emptying and reduces glucose absorption, potentiating insulin effect
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use or monitor glucose levels very closely with potential insulin dose reduction

caution_supplements.name: Alpha-lipoic acid
caution_supplements.mechanism: May modestly improve insulin sensitivity and glucose utilization
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood glucose; minor dose adjustments may be needed with prolonged use

caution_supplements.name: Bitter melon extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Contains compounds that may enhance glucose uptake and reduce blood glucose
caution_supplements.action: Educate patient on potential minor hypoglycemic effects; maintain glucose monitoring

caution_supplements.name: Cinnamon
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak insulin-mimetic properties may slightly enhance glucose control
caution_supplements.action: Generally safe at culinary doses; monitor for any additive glucose-lowering effects

avoid_foods.name: High-glycemic refined carbohydrates (white bread, sugary beverages, pastries)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Causes rapid postprandial glucose spikes that may overwhelm basal insulin coverage and increase hyperglycemic variability
avoid_foods.action: Strongly counsel patient to minimize or eliminate; emphasize structured carbohydrate intake with appropriate meal timing relative to insulin

caution_foods.name: Simple sugars and desserts
caution_foods.mechanism: May cause postprandial glucose elevation; however, basal insulin provides background coverage
caution_foods.action: Educate on portion control and carbohydrate counting; encourage consumption with protein/fat to slow absorption

caution_foods.name: Alcohol (especially on empty stomach)
caution_foods.mechanism: Impairs hepatic gluconeogenesis and may increase hypoglycemia risk, particularly with acute intake
caution_foods.action: Advise moderation, food consumption with alcohol, and awareness of delayed hypoglycemic symptoms

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: Delays gastric emptying and glucose absorption, potentially causing unpredictable postprandial glucose response
caution_foods.action: Patient should maintain consistent meal composition; excessive fat intake may complicate insulin timing

monitoring_notes: Insulin glargine has minimal direct drug-metabolism interactions (not hepatically metabolized), but supplements/foods affecting glucose utilization or insulin sensitivity require vigilant glucose monitoring and potential dose adjustments. Patient education on consistent carbohydrate intake, meal timing, and recognition of hypoglycemic symptoms is critical for optimal glycemic control.
